coupling: The first rank-bound repair permits rank 11 and sizes its original inc, cnt, and dimp tables to 11, so that intermediate commit reads a rank-11 compressed struct field safely. The later indexing rewrite retains that limit but replaces those tables with a new ten-element dimp table. Its rank check consults the limit established in the earlier commit, letting rank 11 reach dimp[10]. The original later commit uses a limit of 10 and is safe; the earlier edited commit has 11-element tables and is safe. A repair must reconcile the limit introduced by the first change with the storage introduced by the second.
